ValidationRule.description: This validation will fire if Maker is selecting Request Support Document for fawri or international transfer.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Release Hold Amount"), ISCHANGED(cc_Maker__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Maker__c, 'Request Supporting Document'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, 'Release Debit Card Transaction')), ($User.LastName <> "Integration") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Maker cannot able to select Request support documents for Fawri & International Transfers.
